import sys,pytest
case=sys.argv[1]
if case=='window':
    import akashic.platform.win.screen as module
    module.GdiScreen.grab_window=lambda *args:None
    test='tests/test_window_capture.py::test_a_responsive_window_is_returned'
elif case=='dispatch':
    import akashic.pipeline.speech as module
    module.make_transcriber=lambda *args,**kwargs:object()
    test='tests/test_speech_transcribers.py::test_the_folder_name_selects_the_backend_without_importing_it'
elif case=='worker':
    import akashic.pipeline.main as module
    module.run_worker=lambda *args:None
    test='tests/test_runner_and_scheduler.py::test_worker_loop_waits_while_paused_and_survives_errors'
elif case=='wiring':
    import akashic.storage.frames as module
    module.FrameStore.add=lambda *args:None
    test='tests/test_capture_screen.py::test_run_capture_wires_storage'
else: raise ValueError(case)
raise SystemExit(pytest.main([test,'-q','--no-cov','--basetemp=.test-tmp/m00-mut-'+case]))
